about: New Tecumseth is a town in Simcoe County, combining Alliston, Beeton, and Tottenham in the countryside west of Highway 400. Alliston is the main urban centre and the site of Honda’s Canadian assembly plant. Farms, the Nottawasaga River, and three distinct downtowns give the town a spread-out, partly rural character. About 44,000 people live in New Tecumseth.
